privacy.title: Your information and privacy
privacy.intro: We handle your information in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.p1: Scheme pages have no advertising or trackers. We do not save your searches or finder answers.
privacy.p2: When you donate, your name, email and PAN are kept only to make your receipt and 80G certificate. PAN is shown masked on screen.
privacy.p3: For a call-back, your name and number are kept only if you consent, and only for the call-back.
privacy.p4: You can ask the trust to correct or delete your information.
privacy.p5: We never store card details. This demo runs in test mode.
